provenance.policy: Generated clothing only. Fixed approved original wearer and each cel fingerprint remain immutable. Explicit shoulder/elbow/wrist guides, seam-limited sleeve regions and original foreground spans; no runtime color inference or wardrobe registration.
provenance.review: 36 dedicated idle cels in eight directions. Uses canonical head ownership only after every owned hair pixel equals the reviewed walking reference. Existing source-specific head/feet equality remains mandatory. New cloth breath follows the original dedicated idle pose by a bounded one-pixel attachment offset; original body is never warped.
